ai_summary: AARNAV Fashions Limited has announced details for its 43rd Annual General Meeting (AGM) on September 30, 2026, outlining key dates for e-voting and shareholder participation, and formally adopted the Secretarial Audit Report for FY 2025-2026. A significant governance red flag is raised by the appointment of the same firm, M/s. Ravi Kapoor & Associates, both as the Secretarial Auditor whose report was adopted and as the Scrutinizer for the AGM voting, which could imply a conflict of interest and compromise the independence of the voting process. Additionally, the email notice cut-off date for the AGM (September 04, 2026) strangely precedes the board meeting date (September 07, 2026) where these details were formally approved.
